title: 🏗️ Terraform Infrastructure
subject: infra
summary: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) configurations for provisioning and managing cloud resources using Terraform modules and deployments.

purpose.intro: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) configurations for provisioning and managing cloud resources using Terraform modules and deployments.

claims.text: **GitHub Actions → AWS**: Workflows authenticate via OIDC, assuming an IAM role
**No secrets stored**: Temporary credentials are issued on-demand

reference.statement: This project uses **OIDC (OpenID Connect)** for secure authentication — no static AWS credentials needed.

reference.topic: Quick Start › Lean Mode (client's own AWS account)
reference.statement: Use the bootstrap stack to create the S3 state bucket, OIDC role, and ECR repos:

snippets.code:
# 1. Configure AWS credentials for the client account
aws configure --profile <project>
export AWS_PROFILE=<project>

# 2. Fill in bootstrap variables
cp terraform/bootstrap/terraform.tfvars.example terraform/bootstrap/terraform.tfvars
# Edit terraform.tfvars with project_name, region, github_org, github_repo

# 3. Run bootstrap (creates S3 bucket + OIDC + ECR)
./terraform/scripts/bootstrap.sh

# 4. Fill in deployment variables
cp terraform/deployment/backend.hcl.example terraform/deployment/backend.hcl
# Edit backend.hcl with the bucket name from bootstrap output
# Edit terraform/deployment/terraform.tfvars with project values

# 5. Deploy infrastructure
cd terraform/deployment
terraform plan
terraform apply
snippets.caption: bash

reference.topic: Quick Start › Shared Mode (Altar's AWS account)
reference.statement: State bucket and OIDC already exist. Skip the bootstrap:

snippets.code:
# 1. Configure backend
cp terraform/deployment/backend.hcl.example terraform/deployment/backend.hcl
# Edit backend.hcl to use the shared Altar state bucket

# 2. Configure deployment
# Edit terraform/deployment/terraform.tfvars with deployment_mode = "shared"

# 3. Deploy
cd terraform/deployment
terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl
terraform plan
terraform apply
snippets.caption: bash

claims.text: **`main.tf` (`deployment/main.tf`)**: Primary infrastructure configuration and module composition
**`providers.tf` (`deployment/providers.tf`)**: Cloud provider configurations and versions
**`variables.tf` (`deployment/variables.tf`)**: Input variable definitions
**`outputs.tf` (`deployment/outputs.tf`)**: Output values for resource references
**`terraform.tfvars` (`deployment/terraform.tfvars`)**: Environment-specific variable values

reference.statement: Main Terraform deployment configuration that orchestrates all infrastructure components:

claims.text: **`main.tf` (`bootstrap/main.tf`)**: S3 state bucket, GitHub OIDC provider, ECR repositories
**`variables.tf` (`bootstrap/variables.tf`)**: Input variables (project_name, region, github_org, github_repo)
**`outputs.tf` (`bootstrap/outputs.tf`)**: State bucket name, deploy role ARN, ECR URLs

reference.statement: One-time setup for lean mode deployments (client's own AWS account):

claims.text: **GitHub OIDC** (`modules/aws/github-oidc/` (`modules/aws/github-oidc/`)): OIDC provider and IAM role for GitHub Actions
**EKS Cluster** (`modules/aws/eks-cluster/` (`modules/aws/eks-cluster/`)): Kubernetes cluster provisioning and configuration
**RDS** (`modules/aws/rds/` (`modules/aws/rds/`)): PostgreSQL database instance management
— SSL is disabled by default for easier development; enable it in production
**S3 Bucket** (`modules/aws/s3-bucket/` (`modules/aws/s3-bucket/`)): Object storage for application assets
— Bucket objects are public by default. Edit the policy for private access.
**Secret Manager** (`modules/aws/secret-manager/` (`modules/aws/secret-manager/`)): Secure storage for application secrets
— Two secrets are created by default:
— — `<project-name>/terraform` — managed by Terraform, do not edit manually
— — `<project-name>/secrets` — edit manually in the AWS console as needed
**VPC** (`modules/aws/vpc/` (`modules/aws/vpc/`)): Virtual Private Cloud networking
**TFC OIDC** (`modules/core/tfc-oidc/` (`modules/core/tfc-oidc/`)): Terraform Cloud OIDC configuration for dynamic AWS credentials
**`bootstrap.sh`**: One-time lean mode bootstrap (S3 bucket + OIDC + ECR)
**`terraform-cloud-create-project.sh`**: Creates TFC project
**`terraform-cloud-create-workspace.sh`**: Creates TFC workspace
**`terraform-cloud-configure-oidc.sh`**: Configures OIDC authentication
**`terraform-local-setup.sh`**: Sets up local development environment

snippets.code:
cd deployment
terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl
terraform plan
terraform apply
terraform fmt -recursive
snippets.caption: bash

claims.text: **Terraform CLI**: `brew install terraform`
**AWS CLI**: `brew install awscli`
**AWS credentials**: Configure via `aws configure --profile <project>` or SSO
For details, see .github/README_CICD.md (`../.github/README_CICD.md`).

reference.statement: Terraform workflows are triggered via GitHub Actions. Set the `AWS_REGION` repository variable to match the project's region.
